clips.title: The story
paras: Darcy asks you to carry a prepared meal from Lakeshire to Guard Parker on the southern road. Gnolls and Blackrock orcs threaten the approaches, and the town's guards are stretched thin.

Darcy, the cook in Lakeshire, has packed a meal for Guard Parker but cannot carry it beyond town herself. Redridge gnolls and roaming orc warbands make the roads outside the gates too dangerous for a civilian. She asks passing travelers to take the food along the road toward Darkshire, where Parker keeps watch.

Guard Parker watches the road south of Lakeshire, along the route toward Duskwood. Redridge's guards have too few reinforcements from the Stormwind army to face the growing gnoll packs and the Blackrock clan in the mountains. Sentries like Parker keep watch alone in hostile country, and a hot meal from town can lift their spirits.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Can you do me a favor? I've prepared a lunch for Guard Parker, but he's out on patrol...he's a big, strong Stormwind guard who can defend himself, but it's much too dangerous out there for a townsperson like me.
So if you deliver his lunch for me, then come back here and I'll give you a free lunch! Parker patrols the stretch of road leading to Duskwood.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she? Such a kind heart she has. Well...let's have it!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks, I could really use the meal. Guarding Lakeshire from the orcs and gnolls is tough work!
